subject: Coord: Friday demo — organizer/ICS conflict and proposed Zoom fallback
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@finova.com>

Cc: Marta Gomez <marta@finova.com>
Date: 2025-10-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo — Friday 2:00pm PT

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. Can we lock in a demo this Friday, Oct 10, at 2:00pm PT? I'll invite our product and security folks (Marta), and we'd like a 45-minute walkthrough + 15 for Q&A.

I attached an .ics (finova_demo_agenda.ics) with the organizer as Marta (she created the event on our side). We mainly use Google Meet but some attendees prefer Zoom — if Redwood prefers Zoom that's fine.

Agenda attached and NDA is on its way.

Best,
Samir
Product Lead, Finova

Attachments: finova_demo_agenda.ics, demo_agenda.pdf

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-01T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Friday 2:00pm PT

Samir — thanks, and appreciate the agenda. Quick heads-up: when I opened the .ics it shows Marta as the organizer but her Google account is a delegate in your tenant; we've seen cases where delegate-created invites block external guest provisioning (RSVPs get dropped and some guests can’t join via Meet).

To avoid last-minute join failures I'd like to propose two options:
- You re-send the invite from a non-delegate organizer (or Marta creates a new event and adds us directly), or
- We host on Redwood's Zoom link and send a fresh invite from our account (we can do host transfer and add Marta as co-host).

Ben — can you confirm we can stand up a temporary Zoom meeting and send an alternate .ics if Samir confirms? If we do Zoom, let's shift to 2:30pm PT to give both sides 30 mins to adjust.

Samir — what do you prefer? If you want us to host, we can send a Zoom invite + updated .ics now. Also attached a quick updated demo deck (Demo_deck_v2.pdf) with the new data examples.

— Alex
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | developers@redwood.com

Attachments: Demo_deck_v2.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-10-01T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — Friday 2:00pm PT

Hi all — Alex is right, we see that organizer/delegate pattern cause join errors in a subset of Finova tenants. We can absolutely host on our Zoom and send a new invite. Proposal: shift to 2:30pm PT so calendars can be updated cleanly.

Operational notes we'll include in the invite:
- New Zoom meeting (Redwood will be host); co-host Marta to be added at start.
- We'll include both Meet and Zoom URLs in the event body and mark Zoom as the recommended fallback.
- We'll attach a regenerated .ics from our account (redwood_zoom_invite.ics) to avoid organizer-shadow issues.

Alex / Lauren — I'll create the Zoom meeting and send the invite. Samir — can you confirm 2:30pm PT works and that we should make the Zoom link the primary join URL? Also please share any security contact who needs the host IPs for whitelist.

Thanks,
Ben
Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference
